effect: The whale lifted on its tethers with the attractions running, completing the fair and Jo’s old plan.
reaction: The dragon waving above the garden is a satisfying payoff, and Kit getting a turn fits the opening invitation.

mostWorthwhile.text: Starting the attractions and then lifting the whale brought the separate constructions together in a memorable finale.

leastWorthwhile.text: Hanging the banner was practical but less engaging; there was no meaningful choice about where to put it.

surprise.text: The banner went across the grounded cradle rather than on the whale, keeping it clear of the tether lines.

arbitrary.text: None felt purposeless, although every decision offered only one combination, so the sequence felt more like following instructions than solving a puzzle.

continue.text: I might continue for another inventive construction and an explanation of how it works, but I would hope for more meaningful choices than this finale offered.
